basic_profile.bio: I'm a Canadian gamer who's just discovering the vast world of Reddit. I recently got into Persona 5 and I'm hooked! I'm also a huge fan of strategy games and occasionally dive into the Fortnite scene for some quick fun. Outside of gaming, I’m a university student studying computer science. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after classes, and on weekends. Currently single, I enjoy exploring new subreddits and engaging in discussions about my favorite games.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a basic understanding of gaming and pop culture, primarily from personal interest and interaction with friends. My knowledge of Persona 5 is growing as I play through the game and engage with community discussions.
